programs.title: Premier League
programs.desc: Manchester City needs a win to stay in the title race with Arsenal, while Bournemouth looks to catch Liverpool in the Champions League places; Man City has beaten Bournemouth in three consecutive meetings since the FA Cup quarterfinals in 2025.

programs.title: The Summit
programs.desc: As the final 6 close in on the summit, they'll have to overcome death-defying terrain and make some of the toughest decisions yet if they want to make it to the top.

programs.title: The Summit
programs.desc: The group is torn between loyalty and strategy as another hiker is voted off the mountain. A massive rocky chasm stands between the final four and the summit.

programs.title: Getting Even With Dad
programs.desc: A small-time thief is lumbered with his teenage son, who was looked after by his sister while he was in prison. Discovering his father's plans to steal a valuable set of coins and set up a bakery shop, the boy pockets the proceeds of the heist and blackmails him into being a better dad - and giving him the attention he deserves.

programs.title: Speed 2: Cruise Control
programs.desc: Annie Porter is thrilled when her boyfriend Alex presents her with two tickets for a cruise ship vacation to the Bahamas. The trip is a peace offering to Annie who has just learned that Alex is a police officer who's been lying to her about his choice of profession. Little do the happy couple know that the disgruntled designer of the ship's computer system has plotted a violent takeover of the vessel.

programs.title: Bill & Ted's Bogus Journey
programs.desc: The would-be heavy metal superstars face the Grim Reaper as they try to reclaim their souls from Hell, return to the land of the living and stop their robot doppelgangers from changing history. Along the way, they must also master their instruments, so they can triumph at the Battle of the Bands. Comedy sequel, starring Keanu Reeves, Alex Winter, William Sadler, Joss Ackland and George Carlin.
